title: Enterprise Knowledge and Action Assistant pilot design

current_prototype.label: EXISTING
current_prototype.summary: Day 10 has read-only knowledge lookup and a simulated local service request with application permission, human confirmation, and JSONL logging. Day 11 adds a bounded agent trace over those two tools. No customer deployment exists.

business_outcome.label: HYPOTHESIZED
business_outcome.summary: Help employees find policy answers and request support without making unapproved changes. A customer must validate users, document scope, service ownership, and acceptable response time.

architecture.label: PROPOSED
architecture.workflow: Authenticated user -> policy retrieval or controlled request proposal -> application authorization and confirmation -> approved service API -> status and audit trace
architecture.model_decisions: Choose whether to answer, retrieve, or propose a service request; summarize validated results.
architecture.deterministic_rules: Identity, authorization, schema validation, confirmation, idempotency, source access, action limits, and audit persistence.
architecture.approval: The user approves the exact request payload before any state-changing call. A changed payload requires a new approval.

unknowns: Which policy documents may each user access?
Which service platform and identity provider will the customer approve?
What latency, quality, retention, and availability targets are acceptable?

lifecycle.label: PROPOSED
lifecycle.evidence: User tasks, data classification, access map

lifecycle.label: PROPOSED
lifecycle.handoff: Approved pilot design and test plan

lifecycle.label: PROPOSED
lifecycle.evidence: Pinned model, prompt, tool contracts, and eval results

lifecycle.label: PROPOSED
lifecycle.evidence: Quality, latency, cost, errors, and drift

lifecycle.label: PROPOSED
lifecycle.evidence: Incident replay as a golden case

golden_cases.label: PROPOSED
golden_cases.expected: Grounded answer with a valid policy source and no write
golden_cases.method: Compare required fact and retrieved source ID

golden_cases.label: PROPOSED
golden_cases.input: Service API times out after a confirmed request
golden_cases.expected: Check idempotency status; do not create a duplicate or claim success without evidence
golden_cases.method: Simulate timeout after commit and retry

golden_cases.label: PROPOSED
golden_cases.input: Unauthorized user asks for a restricted policy
golden_cases.expected: No restricted content returned or logged
golden_cases.method: Run with denied actor context and inspect output and trace

pilot_conditions.label: PROPOSED
pilot_conditions.go: Security review, business UAT, and hard regression gates pass; owner accepts measured pilot limits.
pilot_conditions.no_go: Unknown access policy, unconfirmed write path, missing rollback, or a high-risk golden case failure.
pilot_conditions.recovery: Stop new actions, preserve traces, replay with pinned bundle, and roll back to read-only mode.

alternative.label: PROPOSED
alternative.option: Fixed retrieval and request workflow without an agent loop
alternative.tradeoff: More predictable and easier to audit; less flexible for requests needing several context-dependent lookups. Start with it if pilot tasks are predictable.

top_risks: Model or prompt change that passes a demo but regresses real cases
next_experiment: Replay the three proposed golden cases against the existing local prototype, label observed results, and revise the pilot design before any integration.
